title: Normalized integral smooth-purity comparison data
statement: Use the fixed finite-field and coefficient data, smooth separated finite-type morphism f of dimension d, and finite coefficient fields of [def-pur-conventions]. The full uniform finite-Tor categories, ordinary scalar restriction, normalized finite exceptional realization, and source pullback/twist/shift define OperationData, ComparisonData and Data exactly as in the attached Lean module. OperationData records closure, exactness and coefficient linearity. ComparisonData additionally records natural purity isomorphisms, normalized exceptional realizations and prescribed finite reductions, canonical source and compact-support scalar comparisons, and the counit-transpose exceptional comparison. Data adds the eight equations of Coherence: the purity square, source and exceptional tensor units, source and exceptional associativity, source and exceptional shift compatibility, and purity shift compatibility. These are the existing mathematical data definitions relocated from the existing comparison interface, without an existence assertion or changed field proposition. The existing operation-property fields are stored in SourceOperationData, TargetOperationData and ScalarOperationData, inherited by OperationData, with their original propositions unchanged. SourceOperationData stores each source property family through the generic proposition-family wrapper PropertyFamily; its projection abbreviations expose the same original properties.
